verdict.rationale: Dropbox provides official first-party SDKs across Swift, .NET, Java, JavaScript, Objective-C, and Python, with dedicated GitHub repos (dropbox-sdk-js, dropbox-sdk-python) showing real code usage, plus OAuth, webhooks, and file API documentation supporting programmatic/agentic integration. Missing for 10: no explicit AI-agent-specific SDK guidance (e.g., function-calling schemas, agent frameworks) and no independent hands-on developer corroboration beyond the vendor docs and repos.
